info.title: 共造 v0.8 模型需求、商家方案与履约沙盒 API
info.description: Implementation contract for services/platform, not a production integration promise. No real payment, printer, slicer, courier, or WeChat authentication. Local authentication uses the documented cookie; hosted requests instead require the managed authentication gate to inject a trusted owner identity. The cookie security scheme models local use only. One owner can act as both customer and farm within their isolated sandbox. Every /api/v2 POST needs an 8–128 character Idempotency-Key. Customer delivery profiles are owner-scoped. New quotes require a saved address and use its server-derived destination; a changed address invalidates unused quotes. Merchant/gateway routes are described separately in MERCHANT_GUIDE.md. v0.7: Local merchant APIs require a registered account cookie, while customer anonymous sandbox sessions remain available. Separate /api/auth routes do not require Idempotency-Key. Address required fields are country-dependent via /api/v2/markets. All payments stay disabled. v0.8 adds owner-scoped capability templates, model-first inquiries, versioned proposals and exact-revision customer acceptance. These are single-owner sandbox flows; a self-declared capability or approved manual plan is not authorization for real manufacturing. Private proposal cost evidence is restricted to merchant inquiry responses. All estimated price and time ranges remain unverified sandbox forecasts.

post.summary: Save original model bytes and analyze STL geometry
post.description: Raw upload, not multipart or JSON metadata. Up to 20 MiB; ASCII STL up to 8 MiB; STL up to 50000 faces. Non-STL formats are stored as review-only without CAD/image parsing. Filename is decodeURIComponent-decoded then normalized. Hash and geometry are derived server-side.

parameters.name: X-File-Name
parameters.description: encodeURIComponent(filename), including supported extension. No path separators after decoding. Normalized stored name is at most 180 characters.

schema.description: Nonempty original file bytes. STL, STEP/STP, 3MF, PNG/JPG/JPEG/WebP extensions accepted.

post.summary: Create sandbox quotes for all current farms
post.description: 15-minute immutable terms. materialKey is selected material; material is RMB yuan cost. Review-only zero amounts are unpriced, not free. No real slicer is called. A saved shipping address is mandatory (ADDRESS_REQUIRED). Destination comes from that address; an inconsistent client value is DESTINATION_MISMATCH. New quotes bind addressRevision/addressFingerprint without duplicating full delivery details.

200.description: Success; all manufacturing, payment and logistics behavior is simulated.

post.summary: Create a sandbox order from one unused quote
post.description: Verifies quote expiry/fingerprint/model version. Automatically sets simulated payment frozen for auto-flow orders and attempts simulated dispatch. Review-only orders stay UNPAID. No real funds or device commands. Also validates current address revision and fingerprint; persists immutable shippingAddress snapshot. Old address-less quotes cannot create new orders.

201.description: Success; all manufacturing, payment and logistics behavior is simulated.

post.summary: Advance a sandbox device or order action
post.description: All actions require explicit demo acknowledgment and state validation. This owner sandbox has no production multi-party RBAC. Device completion, delivery and acceptance are user-driven simulations.

SandboxCookie.name: coforge_sandbox
SandboxCookie.description: Local sandbox only. Established by GET /api/v2/session. Hosted mode uses the managed authentication gate; clients must not self-assert the internal identity header.

AccountCookie.name: coforge_account
AccountCookie.description: Local email/password or configured OIDC account session. Required for merchant routes; hosted deployment uses managed identity instead.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique per owner command. Reuse unchanged for retries. Same key with different normalized command payload returns 409. Replays preserve original business result and return current workspace.

ApiError.description: Structured API error. requestId may be absent for errors from the local/Worker wrapper. See API_V2.md for codes and state gates.

shippingAddress.description: Immutable delivery snapshot at order creation; later profile edits do not change it. Historical orders may omit it.

settlementAttempt.description: Current simulated operation; its id must be echoed when resolving. No payment provider transaction.

refundRequest.description: Current simulated operation; its id must be echoed when resolving. No payment provider transaction.

settlementHistory.description: Previous completed attempts retained when a new attempt is created. Historical v0.4 records may omit this field.

refundHistory.description: Previous completed attempts retained when a new attempt is created. Historical v0.4 records may omit this field.

acceptedAt.description: Unix milliseconds. Absent until the corresponding simulated event.

settledAt.description: Unix milliseconds. Absent until the corresponding simulated event.

refundedAt.description: Unix milliseconds. Absent until the corresponding simulated event.

settlementBreakdown.description: New records use merchant receivable for settlement; full customer payment remains refund basis. Old completed gross settlements are not rewritten.

Order.description: Independent production/payment/logistics/acceptance/settlement/dispute/refund states. status is a UI projection, not the authority for transition validation. New orders persist shippingAddress and addressRevision; older orders are not backfilled with invented delivery details.

Workspace.description: Owner-private public projection. Quotes, idempotency ledger and blob keys are omitted. Includes owner-private customerProfile and order delivery snapshots; these must not be exposed to another owner. v0.8 may include public inquiries, excluding proposal economics.

modelId.description: Omitted or null uses the default.

material.description: Omitted or null uses the default.

quality.description: Omitted or null uses the default.

qty.description: Omitted or null uses the default.

unit.description: Omitted or null uses the default.

destination.description: Prefer omission: derived from saved customer address. If present must exactly match; null or a mismatch returns DESTINATION_MISMATCH. No default.

QuoteRequest.description: Creation options are optional, but a complete saved shipping address is required. Server derives destination and chooses sandbox farms. Client prices and geometry are not authoritative.

OrderRequest.description: No client fingerprint or amount required. Snapshot, expiry, one-time use and model version are checked server-side. Saved shipping address must still match quote addressRevision and addressFingerprint; otherwise ADDRESS_CHANGED, or ADDRESS_REQUIRED if absent.

requestId.description: Current order.refundRequest.id, not the HTTP response requestId.

amountCents.description: Optional; if supplied, must equal the full order total. Partial refund not implemented.

ActionRequest.description: Sandbox actions only. Acceptance sets READY, never releases money. Settlement/refund result actions require the active operation ID. Paid cancellation requests a refund; pending production occupancy prevents refund approval. One owner can simulate both parties; not production RBAC.

ActionResponse.description: Contains order and/or device depending on action; reset returns reset=true. Updated workspace is always present.

phone.description: Trimmed; 5–20 digits; + only at the first position. No SMS verification.

countryCode.description: Normalized to uppercase; no external country/postal validation.

province.description: CN requires one of 31 mainland provinces/regions/municipalities. Accepted short names are normalized to official full names.

district.description: Country-specific; CN and NZ require this field. Non-applicable hidden fields are normalized empty.

postalCode.description: Required according to market. String preserves letters, spaces, hyphens and leading zeroes; CN optional for backward compatibility.

ShippingAddress.description: Country-specific required/visible fields come from /api/v2/markets. CN requires province, city and district; SG requires postalCode without province/city; HK/MO have no postalCode. Unknown two-letter countries use generic manual-review template. Format validation only.

CustomerProfileRequest.description: Full replacement. shippingAddress=null explicitly clears or defers address entry. Request destination and addressRevision cannot override server values.

addressRevision.description: Increments only when normalized shipping address changes, including removal.

destination.description: Derived server-side from CN province; all non-CN and unsupported shipping regions use other. Null without address.

riskReserveBps.description: Reserve markup applied to estimated costs, NOT a statistical print failure probability.

targetMarginBps.description: Target profit divided by merchant manufacturing revenue, excluding shipping and platform fee. Predicted, not guaranteed actual profit.

riskReserveBps.description: Reserve markup applied to estimated costs, NOT a statistical print failure probability.

targetMarginBps.description: Target profit divided by merchant manufacturing revenue, excluding shipping and platform fee. Predicted, not guaranteed actual profit.

PricingSummary.description: Customer-visible selling amounts, not private production costs. merchantReceivable = manufacturing + shipping; customerTotal = merchantReceivable + platformFee. Rounded unit average is informational; use total as authority.

BatchEstimate.description: Unverified bounding-box grid estimate. Does not produce toolpaths or check supports, brim or physical collisions. Not cross-customer batching.

ForecastDays.description: [minimum, maximum] calendar-day forecast, not a reserved capacity or carrier SLA.

toleranceMm.description: Requested dimensional tolerance in millimetres; separate from layer height.

requestedDeliveryDate.description: Empty or YYYY-MM-DD within the next two years, not before current UTC day. Target only; does not automatically promise delivery.

InquiryRequirements.description: Optional customer needs; custom requirements trigger merchant review.

items.description: Layer-height option, not a dimensional tolerance promise.

farmId.description: Underlying sandbox pricing/production line, not a real merchant identifier.

CapabilityInput.description: Merchant-declared sandbox service configuration. Process/material combinations are validated; AUTO_ESTIMATE only supports FDM PLA/PETG and compatible simple requests. Referenced devices are inventory records only. This never enables real manufacturing or grants hardware verification.

items.description: Layer-height option, not a dimensional tolerance promise.

Capability.description: Merchant-declared sandbox service configuration. Process/material combinations are validated; AUTO_ESTIMATE only supports FDM PLA/PETG and compatible simple requests. Referenced devices are inventory records only. This never enables real manufacturing or grants hardware verification.

CapabilityRequest.description: Optimistic concurrency protection; disabled or incompatible configurations cannot be used for new inquiries.

InquiryRequest.description: Saved shipping address is required. AUTO requests merchant material advice. Model metadata and amount fields are derived server-side, not trusted from the client.

quality.description: Layer-height option, not a dimensional tolerance promise.

estimatedCostCents.description: Merchant-private cost declaration; server may raise the pricing baseline using its own estimate.

ProposalRequest.description: Merchant-only. Server validates compatibility, optimistic revision and minimum manufacturing price against costs, target margin, minimum order profit and minimum hourly profit. Does not modify an accepted order. Latest dispatch days must not be shorter than the declared productionHours.

InquiryAcceptanceRequest.description: Accept only the current, unexpired proposal with unchanged model/address/capability/pricing snapshots. Creates a simulated frozen-payment order. Manual approved plans remain REVIEW_REQUIRED until production validation; no real money moves or printer starts.

quality.description: Layer-height option, not a dimensional tolerance promise.

Proposal.description: Public approved terms/history; no private estimated costs or profitability evidence. Proposal expiry is 15 minutes; only latest revision is acceptable.

Inquiry.description: Public projection of the owner-scoped inquiry and its proposal history. Customer cannot alter server-derived proposal amounts.

proposalEconomics.description: Merchant-private cost/floor evidence. Never returned by public inquiries or workspace endpoints.
